event_text: CISA, the FBI and the NSA urge immediate patching of the PHP2Shell flaws
NSA says some internal systems were affected during scheduled routine maintenance
DNI says on Fox Business that PHP patching left some NSA systems not coming back up
DNI tells a House committee the outages were not a coordinated or state-sponsored attack
House Intelligence Committee's top Democrat says he has seen no evidence of a malicious actor
White House publishes DNI and Secretary Rubio remarks: no indication of a cyberattack
Outlets report the network still partly down for a third day; most staff told to stay home
Senate Democratic Leader asks for an intelligence red team to test the no-attack assessment
The NSA says it is operating under normal conditions; staff return on staggered arrivals
